title: ECB’s Lagarde: We'll decide on rates meeting by meeting
summary: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said during the European trading session on Friday that the decision on interest rates by the central bank will be meeting by meeting.

title: Silver Correction Ends at 62.27—Can 68.32 Unlock the Path to 80.32?

title: Euro: Hawkish ECB offers limited support against US Dollar - ING
summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole highlights that recent European Central Bank commentary remains broadly hawkish, with limited pushback from the dovish camp.

title: British Pound: BoE on hold sparks Sterling softness – Danske Bank
summary: Danske Bank’s Danske Research Team highlights that the Bank of England left Bank Rate at 3.75% with a 6-3 vote, disappointing hawkish market expectations and triggering GBP weakness and lower rates.
